interpreted_intent: A tasteful, sensual beach-fashion photograph of a clearly adult woman, using the attached portrait only as appearance reference, with a bikini, visible natural thigh gap, sunlit shoreline, low rear camera angle, and an unmistakable back-view composition.
subject: A clearly adult woman in her mid-twenties whose long dark wavy hair and refined facial features are guided by the attached reference portrait.
setting: A bright ocean shoreline with pale sand, gentle surf, and warm late-afternoon sun.
event: She stands barefoot at the waterline with her back toward the camera and a slight over-shoulder turn.
visual_priorities: A clear full-body rear view from a tasteful low camera angle with a naturally visible thigh gap.
Warm sunlight outlining her hair, shoulders, and silhouette against the sparkling sea.
baseline_prompt_en: Create a photorealistic beach fashion editorial featuring a clearly adult woman in her mid-twenties wearing a bikini, guided by the reference portrait's long dark wavy hair and refined facial features. She stands barefoot at the sunlit waterline with her back toward the camera, turning her head slightly over one shoulder while her body remains a clear back view. Frame her full body from a tasteful low camera angle behind her; her relaxed, naturally separated stance creates a visible thigh gap with believable anatomy. Warm late-afternoon sunlight rims her hair and shoulders, translucent sea spray glows around her calves, and gentle waves, pale sand, and a bright horizon form a clean coastal backdrop. Keep the mood confident, serene, and high-end, with realistic skin texture and subtle editorial depth.
